mergedParams.userDescription: Neon glow effect animating around text outlines.

prompts.prompt: Create a preset that generates an animated neon glow outline effect around text, inspired by classic 80s neon signage. Think of this as creating a video effect where the text appears to be a real neon tube sign with electricity pulsing through it. The glow should animate continuously around the text perimeter like electricity traveling through the tubes, with occasional flicker effects for authenticity. Use a multi-layered approach: base text layer, multiple glow layers with different blur radii (inner sharp glow at 2px, middle glow at 8px, outer ambient glow at 20px), and an animated stroke layer that traces the outline. The animation should follow a path around each letter's outline, creating a 'writing' effect that loops seamlessly. Include random flicker intervals to simulate electrical fluctuations in real neon signs. The glow color should subtly shift between slight hue variations to simulate the plasma effect inside neon tubes.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with TextAtom as the core element, wrapped in multiple effect layers. Use containerProps.className='relative inline-block' for the main container. Apply three separate glow effects using the effects array: 1) Inner glow with textShadow animating from '0 0 2px currentColor' to '0 0 4px currentColor' over 2 seconds with ease-in-out easing, 2) Middle glow using filter with drop-shadow, 3) Outer ambient glow with larger blur radius. For the traveling outline effect, use a combination of strokeDasharray and strokeDashoffset animations on an SVG text element overlaid on the TextAtom. Set stroke-dasharray to the text perimeter length and animate stroke-dashoffset from 0 to negative perimeter length over 3 seconds, looping infinitely. For flicker effect, use opacity keyframes at random intervals (e.g., at 0.3s, 0.7s, 1.4s) dropping to 0.7 briefly. Use will-change: filter, opacity, transform for GPU acceleration. Timing should be relative with the main loop at 3 seconds and flicker effects as sub-animations.

prompts.prompt: Design a cyberpunk-style animated neon glow that pulses and breathes around text outlines, synchronized with audio beats if available. Visualize this as a futuristic holographic display where the text edges emit dynamic light that responds to sound frequencies. The glow should have a dual-color gradient (cyan to magenta) that shifts based on audio intensity or time. Create a 'breathing' effect where the glow expands and contracts rhythmically, with sharper, more aggressive pulses on beat drops. Add scan line interference patterns that occasionally disrupt the glow, creating a glitchy, high-tech aesthetic. The outline should have a data-stream effect with small particles or dots traveling along the text edges at varying speeds, representing data flow in a cyberpunk interface.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with className='flex items-center justify-center w-full h-full bg-black' as the container. Implement TextAtom with initial className='text-6xl font-bold text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 to-magenta-500'. Create waveform effects for audio-reactive behavior: use 'scale' effect with audioProperty='waveform', sensitivity=0.8, and threshold=0.3 to make the glow pulse with audio. For the breathing effect without audio, use generic effects with scale animating from 1 to 1.1 over 2 seconds with 'ease-in-out' easing. Apply multiple text-shadow layers in the effects array: animate from '0 0 10px rgba(0,255,255,0.5), 0 0 20px rgba(255,0,255,0.3)' to '0 0 20px rgba(0,255,255,0.8), 0 0 40px rgba(255,0,255,0.5)'. For scan lines, overlay a semi-transparent BaseLayout with animated linear-gradient background using CSS custom properties. Create particle effects using multiple absolutely positioned ShapeAtom components with className='absolute w-1 h-1 bg-cyan-400 rounded-full' animated along bezier curves using translateX and translateY in the effects array. Set different animation durations (1.5s, 2s, 2.5s) for particles to create varied movement speeds.

prompts.prompt: Develop a minimalist, elegant neon glow effect that traces individual letter outlines sequentially, like a calligrapher drawing with light. Picture this as a refined, artistic interpretation where each letter is 'written' with a glowing pen, one after another, with the glow trailing behind the drawing motion. The effect should feel organic and hand-drawn rather than mechanical. Start with no glow, then as the invisible pen moves along each letter's outline, it leaves behind a soft, warm glow that gradually intensifies. Once a letter is complete, its glow settles into a gentle, steady luminescence while the next letter begins. Add subtle light bloom effects that briefly flare when the pen changes direction or completes a stroke. The overall timing should feel deliberate and meditative, like watching an artist at work.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout using className='relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-900'. If using caption data, create individual TextAtom components for each word with staggered timing based on word.relativeStart. For each TextAtom, apply a custom effect sequence: start with opacity: 0 and textShadow: 'none', then animate to opacity: 1 with textShadow: '0 0 8px rgba(255,235,205,0.8), 0 0 16px rgba(255,235,205,0.4)' over 0.5 seconds per word. Use 'ease-out' easing for a natural deceleration. For the drawing effect, consider using SVG masks with stroke-dashoffset animation if more precise control is needed. Apply a subtle scale effect from 0.95 to 1 during the reveal for added elegance. Add a brief 'flare' effect at completion using a spike in blur and brightness filters: animate filter from 'blur(0px) brightness(1)' to 'blur(1px) brightness(1.3)' and back over 0.2 seconds. Use fitDurationTo: 'children' on the parent BaseLayout to automatically adjust timing based on text length. Consider using an internal effect preset for the glow sequence to maintain consistency across letters.

prompts.prompt: Build a retro arcade-style neon glow that flickers and buzzes around text like an old arcade machine display. Imagine the text as part of a vintage arcade cabinet where the neon tubes are slightly degraded, creating inconsistent lighting with charming imperfections. The glow should have a warm, nostalgic color (hot pink or electric blue) with visible 'hot spots' where the neon burns brighter. Add random voltage fluctuations that cause the entire text to briefly dim or surge in brightness. Include a subtle 60Hz flicker that gives the authentic CRT/neon combination feel. The outline glow should have visible segments, as if made from individual neon tube pieces connected together, with slightly different intensities at the connection points.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Create BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative bg-black p-8' and style={{ isolation: 'isolate' }} for proper layering. Use TextAtom with className='text-7xl font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-pink-500'. Implement a complex flicker pattern using effects array with multiple opacity keyframes: [0, 1], [0.016, 0.94], [0.032, 1], [0.048, 0.92], creating a 60Hz flicker feel when looped over 0.048 seconds. For the main glow, use multiple text-shadow layers with slightly offset colors to create chromatic aberration: '2px 2px 4px rgba(255,20,147,0.5), -2px -2px 4px rgba(30,144,255,0.3), 0 0 20px rgba(255,20,147,0.8)'. Add 'hot spots' by overlaying absolutely positioned BaseLayout divs with className='absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none' containing radial-gradient backgrounds positioned at text edges. For voltage fluctuations, use random opacity drops in the effects timeline at intervals like [2.3, 0.6], [2.31, 1], [5.7, 0.7], [5.71, 1]. Create segmented appearance using CSS repeating-linear-gradient as a mask or clip-path on an overlay element. Use transform: translateZ(0) to force GPU acceleration and reduce flicker jank.

prompts.prompt: Create an organic, liquid neon effect where the glow flows around text outlines like luminescent liquid mercury. Envision this as if the text is submerged in a glowing, viscous fluid that constantly shifts and morphs around the letterforms. The glow should have a fluid, blob-like quality with irregular edges that undulate and merge. Use metaball-like effects where nearby glow areas attract and merge together, creating smooth connections between close letter parts. The animation should feel alive and unpredictable, with different areas of the text pulsing at slightly different rates. Add refractive distortion effects that make the text appear to bend light around its edges, similar to looking through water or glass.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Build with BaseLayout using className='relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-900 to-black'. Place TextAtom with className='text-6xl font-bold relative z-10'. Create the liquid glow using SVG filters: define a <filter> with <feGaussianBlur> (stdDeviation='4'), <feColorMatrix> (for goo effect), and <feComposite>. Apply filter via style prop on a duplicated text layer behind the main text. Animate the blur's stdDeviation from 3 to 8 over 3 seconds with sine-wave easing for organic movement. For metaball merging, use CSS filter: blur(8px) contrast(15) on a container div to create the goo effect. Add multiple animated blob shapes using ShapeAtom components with className='absolute w-20 h-20 bg-blue-400 rounded-full mix-blend-screen' positioned near text edges. Animate their transform with translateX and translateY using sine and cosine functions for circular motion paths. For refraction, apply a subtle backdrop-filter: blur(2px) on an overlay element. Use different animation durations (2.8s, 3.3s, 4.1s) for each blob to avoid synchronization. Consider using 'spring' easing for more organic motion feel.

prompts.prompt: Design a high-energy, explosive neon glow effect that bursts outward from text outlines in waves, like shockwaves of light emanating from each letter. Think of this as a powerful energy discharge where the text generates periodic light pulses that expand outward before fading. Each pulse should start as a tight, bright outline and rapidly expand while decreasing in intensity. Layer multiple pulses with different timing to create a continuous ripple effect. Add electric arc effects that occasionally jump between nearby letters, creating dramatic light bridges. The base glow should have a hot, white-blue core with cooler colors at the edges, simulating extreme heat and energy.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout className='relative flex items-center justify-center w-full h-full bg-black overflow-visible'. Use TextAtom with className='text-8xl font-black relative z-20 text-white'. Create pulse waves using multiple absolutely positioned BaseLayout divs, each containing a duplicate TextAtom with className='absolute inset-0 text-8xl font-black'. Animate each pulse layer with effects array: scale from 1 to 1.5, opacity from 1 to 0, and filter from 'blur(0px) brightness(2)' to 'blur(8px) brightness(0.5)' over 1.5 seconds. Stagger pulse animations at 0.5-second intervals using different start times in AnimationRange. For the base glow, use box-shadow with multiple layers: '0 0 10px rgba(255,255,255,1), 0 0 20px rgba(100,200,255,0.8), 0 0 30px rgba(0,100,255,0.6)'. Create electric arcs using SVG <path> elements with stroke='url(#lightning-gradient)' animated with stroke-dashoffset. Use transform-origin: center for scaling animations. Add will-change: transform, opacity, filter for performance. Consider using an internal effect preset called 'pulse-wave' for reusability across multiple text elements.

prompts.prompt: Develop a sophisticated matrix-rain style neon glow that cascades down text outlines like digital rain on the letterforms. Visualize streams of glowing code or symbols flowing along the text edges, creating a dynamic data-visualization effect. The glow should consist of tiny moving light particles that follow the contours of each letter, occasionally branching off or merging with other streams. Include varying particle speeds and intensities to create depth, with some particles moving quickly and brightly while others drift slowly and dim. Add occasional 'data burst' moments where particles cluster and create intense glow spots before dispersing. The overall effect should feel like the text is a conduit for flowing digital energy.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Create BaseLayout with containerProps={{ className: 'relative w-full h-full bg-black', style: { perspective: '1000px' } }}. Use TextAtom with className='text-7xl font-mono font-bold text-green-400 relative z-10'. Generate particle streams using multiple ShapeAtom components (30-50 particles) with className='absolute w-0.5 h-4 bg-gradient-to-b from-green-400 to-transparent'. Position particles along text outline using JavaScript calculations in presetExecution. Animate each particle with unique effects: translateY from -20 to container height + 20, opacity cycling between 0.3 and 1, with random duration between 2-4 seconds. Use linear easing for constant fall speed. For glow effect, apply text-shadow: '0 0 10px rgba(0,255,0,0.5)' as base, then animate to '0 0 20px rgba(0,255,0,0.8)' during data bursts. Create burst effects by temporarily scaling nearby particles to scaleX: 3 and increasing opacity to 1 when they reach certain Y positions. Use mix-blend-mode: 'screen' on particles for additive blending. Consider fetching random positions from preset-stdlib helper for particle placement. Implement particle recycling by resetting translateY when particles exit viewport.

prompts.prompt: Create an atmospheric, aurora borealis-inspired neon glow that dances and shifts around text outlines like the northern lights. Picture ethereal curtains of colored light that wave and ripple around the letterforms, with gradients that slowly shift through green, blue, purple, and pink hues. The glow should have a vertical wave motion that travels horizontally across the text, creating the illusion of light curtains passing through. Add subtle particle effects that float upward like light ions, contributing to the mystical atmosphere. The intensity should ebb and flow naturally, with moments of brilliant color followed by softer, more subdued glows. Include occasional 'solar flare' moments where the entire effect brightens dramatically.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Build with BaseLayout using className='relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-b from-gray-950 to-blue-950 overflow-hidden'. Place TextAtom with className='text-6xl font-light tracking-widest text-white/90 relative z-10'. Create aurora curtains using multiple BaseLayout layers with className='absolute inset-0 opacity-60 mix-blend-screen'. Apply animated linear-gradient backgrounds using CSS custom properties: background: 'linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, rgba(0,255,100,0.3), rgba(0,100,255,0.3), transparent)'. Animate gradient angle from 0deg to 360deg over 8 seconds for rotation effect. Use transform: skewY with sine-wave animation from -3deg to 3deg over 4 seconds for wave motion. Apply multiple text-shadow layers that animate through color values: from '0 0 20px rgba(0,255,100,0.4)' through '0 0 20px rgba(100,0,255,0.4)' to '0 0 20px rgba(255,0,100,0.4)' over 6 seconds. Create floating particles using ShapeAtom with className='absolute w-1 h-1 bg-white/30 rounded-full blur-[1px]'. Animate particles with translateY from 100% to -100% and translateX using sine function for drift. For solar flares, use brightness filter animation from 1 to 1.5 at specific intervals. Layer multiple aurora curtains with different animation durations (7s, 9s, 11s) to avoid repetition.

prompts.prompt: Design a glitch-art neon glow that corrupts and reconstructs around text outlines, creating a dystopian digital aesthetic. Imagine the glow as a damaged holographic projection that struggles to maintain coherence, with data corruption causing the outline to fragment, shift, and reassemble. The glow should split into RGB channels that separate and misalign before snapping back together. Add digital noise patterns that occasionally overwhelm the glow, creating static interference. Include sharp, angular distortions where sections of the outline suddenly shift position or duplicate. The effect should feel unstable and unpredictable, like viewing text through a malfunctioning display terminal.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout className='relative w-full h-full bg-black overflow-hidden'. Create three TextAtom layers for RGB channel separation, each with className='absolute inset-0 text-7xl font-bold mix-blend-screen'. Set first layer color to 'text-red-500', second to 'text-green-500', third to 'text-blue-500'. Animate each layer's translateX separately: red from -2px to 2px, green from 0 to -3px, blue from 2px to 0, all over 0.1 seconds with 'steps(2)' easing for sharp glitch effect. Loop with random intervals between 1-3 seconds. For main glow, use filter animation with values cycling through: 'drop-shadow(0 0 10px currentColor) brightness(1) contrast(1)', 'drop-shadow(0 0 20px currentColor) brightness(1.5) contrast(2)', 'drop-shadow(0 0 5px currentColor) brightness(0.5) contrast(0.5)'. Add noise overlay using BaseLayout with CSS background-image using data URI of noise pattern, animated opacity from 0 to 0.3 randomly. Create displacement glitches using transform with random translateX and skewX values at specific keyframes: [1.2, { translateX: '10px', skewX: '5deg' }], [1.21, { translateX: '0', skewX: '0' }]. Use clip-path animations to create horizontal scan line cuts. Apply will-change: transform, filter for performance.

prompts.prompt: Build a bio-luminescent, organic neon glow that pulses around text outlines like deep-sea creature bioluminescence. Envision the text as a living organism with a glowing nervous system, where light travels along the letter paths in waves, similar to neural impulses. The glow should have a soft, ethereal quality with gentle pulsations that vary in intensity and speed. Create branching tendrils of light that occasionally extend from the main outline, reaching out before retracting. Add a subtle 'breathing' rhythm where the entire glow expands and contracts as if the text is alive. Include random bio-electric sparks that briefly illuminate sections with increased intensity, mimicking synaptic firing.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Create BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-radial from-blue-950/50 to-black'. Use TextAtom with className='text-6xl font-medium text-cyan-300/80 relative'. Implement bio-pulse using effects array with multiple overlapping animations: opacity from 0.6 to 1 over 3 seconds with 'ease-in-out', scale from 1 to 1.02 over 4 seconds with 'ease-in-out', creating organic rhythm. Apply animated text-shadow with multiple layers: '0 0 15px rgba(0,255,200,0.4), 0 0 30px rgba(0,200,255,0.2), 0 0 45px rgba(0,150,255,0.1)'. For neural impulses, create small ShapeAtom elements with className='absolute w-2 h-2 bg-cyan-400 rounded-full blur-sm' that travel along text paths using bezier curve animations in translateX/Y. Implement tendrils using SVG <path> elements with animated stroke-dasharray creating extension/retraction effect. For bio-electric sparks, use brief opacity and scale spikes at random intervals: sudden jump to opacity: 1 and scale: 1.5 for 0.1 seconds. Add subtle hue-rotate filter animation from 0deg to 30deg over 10 seconds for color variation. Consider using waveform effects if audio is available, mapping low frequencies to pulse intensity. Use pointer-events: none on all glow layers to maintain text interactivity.
